dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid-toned, high-intensity pixel clusters located on the posterior-lateral quadrant, lacking internal gradients and appearing as localized asymmetrical concentrations.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form a scalene triangle; four high-intensity blobs on the posterior flank form an irregular polygonal relationship.
